title: Double Machine Learning for Panel Data: Identification, Specification, and a Bank Regulation Effect
abstract: arXiv:2611.07249v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper examines robustness and causal interpretation of panel estimates using double/debiased machine learning. The prototype treatment setup is the 2018 US banking regulation. Under common treatment timing, we characterize identification and nuisance restrictions and derive exact bank-level representations of specified "within" and "first-difference" scores. Simulations assess panel model transformation-induced specification bias and inference under weaker overlap. Empirically, estimates vary with asset-size classification and prior growth. Prior-growth adjustment reduces overlap-weighted estimates across four Machine Learners (ML); doubly robust estimates depend on the fitted propensity and concentrated weights. Both bank groups received relief, so we estimate differential exposure effects. The findings highlight specification issues and the relation between functional-form robustness and causal identification.

translated_title: 面板数据的双重机器学习：识别、模型设定与银行监管效应
translated_abstract: 本文利用双重/去偏机器学习考察面板估计的稳健性与因果解释。原型处理设定为2018年美国银行监管改革。在共同处理时点下，本文刻画了识别与冗余参数限制条件，并推导出“组内”与“一阶差分”得分在银行层面的精确表示。模拟实验评估了面板模型变换引起的设定偏差以及在较弱重叠条件下的推断表现。实证结果表明，估计值随资产规模分类与前期增长情况而变化；对前期增长进行调整会降低四种机器学习方法下的重叠加权估计值，而双重稳健估计依赖于拟合的倾向得分和集中的权重。由于两类银行均获得了监管放松，本文进一步估计了差异化的暴露效应。研究发现突出了模型设定问题以及函数形式稳健性与因果识别之间的关系。
tldr: 本文将双重/去偏机器学习拓展至面板数据，刻画了共同处理时点下“组内”与“一阶差分”估计量的识别条件，并以2018年美国银行监管改革为例，揭示了模型设定选择与函数形式稳健性对因果识别和估计结果的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper extends double/debiased machine learning to panel data by characterizing identification and nuisance restrictions for "within" and "first-difference" scores under common treatment timing, and uses the 2018 US bank regulation to demonstrate how specification choices and functional-form robustness affect causal identification and estimates.
